Pipes
SWIM was given pipes in place of Ex tabs. Very good roll for about an hour and a half to two hours. But it was different that an ex roll. not quite as hyper or jittery. And it just felt all around different. Then the come down hit like a ton of bricks. It was the most awful pain SWIM has ever experienced. Horrible throbbing headache. Nausea. vomiting. dizziness. whole body pains. painful to move. felt like SWIM's head might literally explode.
